segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: WHHOOOOOOOOOOSH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You crash into something soft, cold, and utterly blinding.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Snow. Tons and tons of freezing, powdery, delicious-smelling snow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You roll over, sputtering and coughing, shaking white flakes out of your eyelashes. The biting Arizona wind is gone. The smell of asphalt and garbage dumpsters is gone. Instead, the air smells crisp and magical—like fresh pine needles, woodsmoke, peppermint, and melted chocolate.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Next to you in the drift, the brass compass gives a tired little pfffft sound, and a sad wisp of black smoke curls out from its gears.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A pair of pointed ears pops out of the snow, followed by a tweed hat.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip sits up, rubs his sore nose, and adjusts his coat with trembling paws. He glances at the broken, smoking compass, quickly stuffs it behind his back, and clears his throat:

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Ahem. And thus concludes our rapid tactical repositioning. Text-book execution. Nothing to it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He turns to look at you, his eyes darting around nervously.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You wouldn't, by any remote stretch of the imagination... happen to know how to repair an eighth-century chronometric flux-spring, would you?

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: No,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you say, brushing snow off your knees.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Where are we?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip doesn't answer right away. He slowly turns around, looking down the ridge.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You follow his gaze—and your breath catches in your throat.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Spread across the valley below is the most extraordinary village you have ever seen.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Hundreds of gingerbread-trimmed cottages nestle against the snowy mountainside, their frosted windows glowing with warm, welcoming amber light. Frozen waterways of glittering ice wind under carved stone bridges, and hot-air balloons decorated like holiday ornaments drift lazily between mountain peaks.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And rising high above the center of the village, towering into the starry sky, is the Grand Clock.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It is an immense, breathtaking mountain of brass, crystal, and glowing clockwork. Towering gear wheels five stories high turn in silent, majestic harmony, bathing the entire valley in a soft, golden radiance.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Welcome,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip whispers, his voice quiet and uncharacteristically solemn.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: To Everfrost.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You stare down at the glowing spires.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Everfrost? What is this place?

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: It's where Christmas comes from,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip says, clutching his coat tighter around his chest.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Or rather... where it is supposed to be kept safe.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Suddenly, the golden glow from the giant clock flickers.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Deep inside the clockwork spires, something groans. A metallic shriek echoes across the valley, so loud it sends snow avalanching down the distant peaks.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The massive, golden hour hand on the Grand Clock violently shudders.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Instead of moving forward... it jerks backward.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: BONGGGGGGG.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A deep, unnatural bell tolls across the village.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: BONG. BONG. BONG.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You count the strikes in your head. Nine... ten... eleven... twelve...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: BONG.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Thirteen.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A cold, violet wave of magical energy ripples outward from the clock tower, sweeping across the village roofs. In an instant, every warm amber window in Everfrost blinks out into darkness.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip’s bushy tail drops between his legs. His eyes go wide with genuine horror.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Pip?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you whisper, the hair on the back of your neck standing up.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: What was that?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip slowly swallows. His exaggerated detective accent is completely gone.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: That...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip whispers into the freezing dark,

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: ...wasn't supposed to happen until tomorrow.
